tei:div.tei:p: rig 'dus rgyun khyer/ ) na moḥbadag dang mtha' yas sems can kun: mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma dang: rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor la: snying nas dad pas skyabs su mchi: ho: rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nas: pha ma 'gro dug sems can kun: tshad med snying rjes sgrol ba'i phyir: smon 'jug don dam byang sems bskyed: hūm̐: ma bcos rig pa stong gsal ngang: lhag mthong snang cha'i rten 'brel kun: lhun grub dag pa rab 'byams kyi: dkyil 'khor chen po lhun rdzogs dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: hūm̐ las skad cig dran rdzogs su: bdag nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos: snang srid zil gnon pad+ma 'byung: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar dmar mdangs: theg gsum rdzogs pa'i brda rtags su: phod kha chos gos ber 'dung mnabs: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsdigs: g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams: mchan khung g.yon na lha lcam mdzes: dbu la pad+ma'i snyen zhu gsol: rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su 'gying: spyi bor tshe dpag med yab yum: mnyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang nas: bde chen byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas lus gang bde bas myos: 126) rdo rje'i srog la dbang thob dmigs: thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: hūm̐ yig mthing ga'i mtha' bskor du: sngags phreng spu shad lta bus 'khor: 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud sbyangs: rnam dag lha yi dal du bsgom: ma grub bar du mi btang ngo: oṃ ā hūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: tshe bsnyon ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru a yur+dz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye tshe bh+rum̐ nri dzaḥsarba sid+dhi hūm̐: tshe 'gugs ni/ oṃ:rang snang zangs mdog dpal gyi ri: lnga ldan rang byung pho brang nas: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: dpal chen grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad: rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas: thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs:

'khor 'das lam gsum bcud bsdus la: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba kun: ye shes klong dgu'i dbyings su bskyil: 'gyur med srog gi ka ba tshugs: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: sngags brjod/ d+darmā dhartu badz+ra rak+ṣa: pad+ma ma ṇis so// bkra shis//
